sources.text: No source recorded for how it is made yet.

steps.note: The ricotta is taken off as it floats and filled into baskets without pressing.

steps.name: bake
steps.note: The ricotta is baked in a wood-fired oven, unsalted, until it smells baked and has no rind.

links.name: Ricotta di bufala (salata, infornata, affumicata), PAT Lazio, in the Atlante dei prodotti tipici (ONAF)

sources.text: The steps and times of the Lazio buffalo-whey ricotta infornata from the regional list of traditional products; Wikipedia for the ricotta baked to a brown, lightly charred crust, with no oven temperature given by either.
